products.name: Collaboration & AI Platform Consolidation Strategy & Roadmap — Commercial
products.short_description: Define the long-term consolidation strategy across collaboration and AI systems — target state, decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, sequencing, and cost model — so the enterprise converges on one supportable platform. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn a two-ecosystem mess into one sustainable platform

A transformation that stalls in permanent coexistence carries double the cost, tools, and risk. This solution defines the long-term platform consolidation strategy across collaboration and AI systems — the target state, the decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, the sequencing, and the sustainability/cost model — so the enterprise converges on one supportable platform instead of running two forever.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Strategy Overview — the consolidation thesis: target platform, what gets retired, and why (sustainability, security, cost efficiency).
  • Current-vs-Target Estate — a method to map the collaboration + AI estate (Microsoft, Google, third-party) to the target and identify redundancy and decommission candidates.
  • Consolidation Roadmap — sequencing, dependencies, decommission gates, and the coexistence-exit criteria that move the program off legacy systems deliberately.
  • 5 supporting scripts — estate/redundancy discovery, target-state conformance validation, a consolidation/cost-savings report, safe decommission-readiness checks, and a scope helper.
  • Testing gates + a Consolidation-Roadmap document template and Best Practices for cost efficiency and long-term platform sustainability.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A clear, documented path to one consolidated collaboration + AI platform — legacy systems retired on a deliberate schedule — delivering sustainability, security, and cost efficiency.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWCONSOL-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only collaboration + AI estate/redundancy inventory for consolidation
    • GWCONSOL-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation of consolidation readiness gaps (default -WhatIf)
    • GWCONSOL-Report.ps1 — Read-only consolidation/cost-savings + decommission-readiness report
    • GWCONSOL-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — Consolidation wave-scope targeting-group builder (default -WhatIf)
    • GWCONSOL-Validation.ps1 — Read-only target-state conformance validation for consolidation waves

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
